quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The capability test validates a representative unknown-response-regression record: a confirmed 500 reproducer, a rejected timeout hypothesis, a parser-field root-cause probe, a regression check that fails before and passes after repair, an original-reproducer rerun, and removal of tagged temporary instrumentation.
The deterministic fixture contains ten hard-negative prompts for confirmed bounded corrections and verifies that they do not trigger the diagnosis capability.
